'''Bespin Motors''' was the manufacturer of numerous air vehicles, and were widely recognized as the primary creator of [[Cloud car/Legends|cloud cars]]. Originally formed as a subsidiary of [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]], Bespin Motors was created specifically to build the immense [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. After the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] began to [[Imperialization/Legends|nationalize]] Incom, the Bespin executives enacted a self-buyout of the corporation. Bespin Motors continued to pioneer the development of cloud cars and were regarded as the dominant manufacturer in the field despite other companies producing competing designs.<ref name="EGVV" /> Bespin Motors later became part of the corporation [[Tendrando Arms]].<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
